title: Voice memo: plan for the week

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Okay. Monday. Quick plan for the week before I get sucked into anything.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Big one first. Balcony App 3.0, the beta go or no-go is Friday. So everything this week kind of bends around that. I want to walk into Friday knowing the answer already, not finding out in the room.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Second, Schema Bridge kickoff with Montague is today. This afternoon, three o'clock. I should get a first draft of the spec down this morning so we're not just, um, waving our hands at each other.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Wednesday is the Ducal Freight call. That's our first real customer for Schema Bridge, so I want to hear what they actually need before we promise anything.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: And Friday, the weekly note to Friar. Short. Actually write it this time.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Oh, and book the flight to Paris. The trade show, the twenty-sixth. I keep saying I'll do it and then I don't. Book the flight, Juliet.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: And, um, one more. Tybalt was grumbling on Friday about depending on Montague for anything. Hear him out at standup, take it into the kickoff. Okay. Coffee, then standup.
